snapshot.comment:
Locally composed approved qualified reference. Latest typed decisions supersede historical inactive/pending labels below. Source rights and permission to release all cited material remain unverified; no restricted process inventories copied. Current PSI equivalence, connected 3.12 exports, protected PV closure and export/restore validation required before release.

Source history:
Implemented reinforced dry diaphragm, NMP/water scenario and composition-specific manufacturing/retirement burden partition. Scientific gaps: dry loading, mesh geometry, capture/solute emissions, solvent recovery energy, real separation and durability remain unverified.

Source qualification, checkpoint51; no new diaphragm-model approval. Brauns et al.2021, DOI10.1149/1945-7111/abda57, TableII and physical-characterization methods, distinguishes helium-pycnometric solid-structure density including closed pores from bulk weight density. For its Zirfon Ref sample, the paper reports2.02g/cm3 and56percent effective porosity after drying, with491+/-11um wet thickness and no observed thickness change on drying. Those are not an independently weighed dry areal mass or a commercial manufacturer recipe. The nominal composition's ideal additive-volume density is2.66458g/cm3, not measured2.02; closed porosity, grade/composition, sample variability and measurement definitions prevent using this difference as a unique PPS/zirconia assay. Earlier computed62.4706percent porosity is an ideal geometric total-void estimate, not demonstrated open-pore fraction, gas permeability or agreement with the same observable measured in the paper. Falling in Agfa's broad interval alone does not validate composition or performance. Brauns supports the PPS-supported NMP phase-inversion process family, not the selected mesh geometry, 0.5kg/m2 dry mass,121.8kg/MW requirement,95percent coating retention,95percent solvent recovery,10kg water or1kWh/kg energy. Solvent/water partitions, utilities and mixed rejects remain engineering assumptions; formal bookkeeping is not industrial fate evidence. Separate hypothetical density/area comparisons are not adopted resizings. No neighbouring gasket change, classification, emission or recovery credit is inferred. Original model history, including its source APPROVED label rather than CLIC authority, follows.
